settings.intro: Every cost of World in Common is published here, from day zero.

settings.heading: The ledger
settings.empty_text: No entries yet. Lines appear here as real receipts come in.
settings.shirts_label: Shirts to sell to keep the project alive
settings.contribution_label: Contribution to the project per shirt
settings.footnote: Amounts are shown exactly as on the receipt. Nothing is estimated, and the page does not add anything up for you.

settings.heading: VAT is not income
settings.text: VAT is shown on its own line, with its own type. It is never counted as project income.

settings.heading: Contribution to the project
settings.text: When a sale brings in more than it costs, the difference is an operating surplus: a contribution to the project. It pays for the next piece of work.

settings.heading: No invented numbers
settings.text: Until a cost is real, the ledger says “Awaiting real cost” or “TBD”. Nothing is estimated.
